methods.label: Clear the denominators and factor
methods.explanation:
Clearing the fractions will reveal a common factor. Because \(x\) and \(y\) are nonzero, multiplying the equation by \(xy\) is reversible and gives
\[
x^2y+2y=xy^2+2x.
\]
Move the terms involving \(xy\) to one side and factor:
\[
x^2y-xy^2=2x-2y,
\qquad
xy(x-y)=2(x-y).
\]
The numbers are distinct, so \(x-y\ne0\). Dividing by this common factor gives \(xy=2\). All canceled quantities are nonzero under the stated conditions, so the answer is \(2\), choice D.
